prompt: A small chamber of rough weathered stone, seen in a first-person view at standing eye height, with stone walls on both sides and a low stone ceiling above. A square grate of heavy hand-forged iron bars is set in a stone frame in the ceiling above the middle of the chamber. The iron grate is shut, its bars filling the square opening in the ceiling. A heavy iron padlock and hasp hold the grate shut at the stone frame. On the left, a low passage with a floor of cobbles runs away out of the frame, and a faint light glows at its far end. The floor of the chamber in the foreground is bare packed earth. Soft daylight falls from the grate in the ceiling and lights the whole chamber. The picture fills the whole frame, edge to edge. Setting: a medieval fantasy world; everything is old and handmade: weathered stone and old brick, rough timber, wrought iron. Style: 1970s comic book art: bold black ink outlines, hand-inked hatching, flat printed colours with visible halftone dots, slightly off-register colour printing, muted earthy palette of browns, ochres, olive and amber, on aged newsprint. Mood: quiet, still and mysterious, a place long left alone.
